doc.title: Preprocessor
doc.para: Preprocessor TJS2 can process conditional compilation expressions (corresponding to C's #if and #endif). These are processed before the script is actually interpreted, allowing parts of the script to be excluded from or included in interpretation depending on conditions. Unlike C preprocessor directives, the style of conditional compilation expressions is free-form and can be written anywhere. There is no requirement to write only one directive per line as in C.

Predefined Variables The version variable represents the current version of TJS2.
As a numeric value, it is in hexadecimal 0x0XYYZZZZ format, where the X portion represents the major version, the YY portion represents the minor version, and ZZZZ represents the release number. For example, 0x02040009 represents version 2.4.9.
